t: You are at Piccadilly Circus tube station, which lies directly beneath Piccadilly Circus itself, with an entrance at every corner. The Bakerloo and Piccadilly lines both stop here, and it is in fare zone one. The station was designed by Charles Holden, an English architect best known for his London Underground stations of the 1920s and 1930s. He also designed the Underground's headquarters at 55 Broadway, Senate House for the University of London, and Bristol Central Library, and he created many war cemeteries in Belgium and northern France.
